metadata.description: Curated sources for practical data science workflows: framing, EDA, validation, responsible-AI mechanics, multimodal and speech modelling, evaluation, reproducibility, and production handoff.
metadata.title: AI Ml Data Science - Sources

foundational_papers_and_books.name: The Elements of Statistical Learning
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Core reference for statistical learning concepts and evaluation foundations.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: An Introduction to Statistical Learning
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Practical ML and statistics reference for model selection, validation, and interpretation.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Datasheets for Datasets
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Dataset documentation framework for governance, provenance, and risk assessment.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Model Cards for Model Reporting
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Standardized reporting template for model performance, intended use, and limitations.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Classic reference on production ML failure modes and maintenance costs.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Hands-On Large Language Models (Alammar & Grootendorst, O'Reilly 2024)
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Chapter 5 is the primary-adjacent source for the modular text-clustering and topic-modeling pipeline (embed -> UMAP -> HDBSCAN -> c-TF-IDF -> representation models); Grootendorst authored BERTopic.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: BERTopic: Neural topic modeling with a class-based TF-IDF procedure
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Defines c-TF-IDF class-based term weighting and the modular clustering-plus-representation topic pipeline.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: UMAP: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection for Dimension Reduction
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Dimensionality-reduction stage of the text-clustering pipeline; nonlinear structure handling versus PCA.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: hdbscan: Hierarchical density based clustering (JOSS 2017)
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Density clustering stage: cluster count not specified in advance, explicit outlier handling.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: uv Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Modern Python project, dependency, and script management for reproducible DS workflows.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: marimo Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Git-friendly, reactive notebooks for exploratory analysis and reviewable DS workflows.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: pandas Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Core tabular data manipulation and analysis reference.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: Polars Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: High-performance dataframe engine with lazy execution for scalable transforms.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: DuckDB Python Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Embedded analytical SQL engine for local reproducible DS analysis.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: scikit-learn Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Core preprocessing, model selection, metrics, threshold tuning, and calibration utilities. Check the installed release against its official documentation before citing API specifics; the former current-version snapshot is unverified.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: LightGBM Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Strong tabular baseline for fast iteration and structured-data experiments.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: CatBoost Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Gradient boosting with strong categorical support and competitive tabular performance.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: PyTorch Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Deep learning framework reference when neural approaches are justified.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: MAPIE Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Prediction intervals and conformal prediction utilities for uncertainty-aware model outputs.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Pandera Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Schema and dataframe validation for DS pipelines and feature contracts.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Great Expectations Core Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Expectation-based validation workflows for dataset and pipeline checks.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Evidently Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Data quality, drift, and monitoring metrics used in DS handoff and validation reviews.

experimentation_and_automation.name: karpathy/autoresearch
experimentation_and_automation.relevance: Autonomous ML experiment agent: bounded modification surface, fixed eval metric (val_bpb), git-as-experiment-ledger, 5-min time budget per run. Reference for Pattern 8.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: MLflow Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage for reproducible DS work.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: Weights & Biases Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Experiment tracking, comparisons, artifact lineage, and collaborative reviews.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: DVC Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Data and pipeline version tracking for reproducible experiments.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: lakeFS Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Git-like versioning for data lakes and branchable data experiments.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: Feast Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Feature-store reference for train/serve parity and reusable feature definitions.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: SQLMesh Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: SQL transformation patterns for staging, intermediate, and marts layers with testing.

llm_data_pipelines.name: TabPFN-3 technical report / Prior Labs
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Tabular foundation model limits are a rows-vs-features tradeoff that changes per release; read the current model card. Licence is non-commercial by default: evaluation that informs commercial decisions counts as commercial use, and distilling TabPFN or its outputs for commercial use needs a commercial licence.

llm_data_pipelines.name: TabICL v2: open tabular foundation model (arXiv 2602.11139)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Open tabular foundation model (code released for inference, pretraining and synthetic-data generation); verify weight availability and licence before treating it as the licence-safe alternative to TabPFN.

llm_data_pipelines.name: TabPFN-2.5 (arXiv 2511.08667)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: TabPFN-2.5 paper (size regimes, win rates vs default XGBoost, distillation engine). Its limits are superseded by later releases; read the current model card. Win-rate figures are model-version-specific; hedge before asserting.

llm_data_pipelines.name: text-dedup (MinHash/LSH deduplication library)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Production-grade MinHash LSH and exact dedup for large text corpora. Used in LLM data pipeline reference.

llm_data_pipelines.name: Min-K% Prob — Contamination Detection (arXiv 2310.16789)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Post-training benchmark contamination detection via minimum-k% token log-probability. Cited in evaluation-patterns.md §10 and llm-data-pipeline.md §4.

llm_data_pipelines.name: Cleanlab Documentation
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Confident learning and label noise detection for supervised ML datasets. Referenced in data-contracts-lineage.md §7 annotation-quality section.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Fairness and Abstraction in Sociotechnical Systems
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary source for connecting fairness definitions to sociotechnical system boundaries and affected populations.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Foundational treatment of differential privacy, composition, and privacy-utility reasoning.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Why Should I Trust You? Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary LIME paper for local post-hoc explanation and its assumptions.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary SHAP paper for additive feature-attribution explanations.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Deep Leakage from Gradients
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Demonstrates privacy leakage from shared gradients, important for federated-learning threat models.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary evidence for memorization and training-data extraction risk.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary CLIP paper for dual-encoder image-text contrastive pretraining and zero-shot transfer.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary SigLIP paper for pairwise sigmoid image-text alignment without global softmax normalization.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: LayoutLM: Pre-training of Text and Layout for Document Image Understanding
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary document-understanding paper combining text and two-dimensional layout.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary latent-diffusion source for compressed-space generation and cross-attention conditioning.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary source for conditional-unconditional guidance and the fidelity-diversity trade-off.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: On Distillation of Guided Diffusion Models
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary source for progressive distillation of guided diffusion sampling.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary Whisper paper for multilingual encoder-decoder ASR, translation, timestamps, and weak supervision.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Connectionist Temporal Classification
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Foundational CTC objective for monotonic sequence alignment with a blank symbol.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Sequence Transduction with Recurrent Neural Networks
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Foundational transducer objective combining acoustic encoding with output-history prediction for streaming recognition.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Natural TTS Synthesis by Conditioning WaveNet on Mel Spectrogram Predictions
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary Tacotron 2 source for text-to-mel acoustic modelling followed by a neural vocoder.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Foundational autoregressive neural waveform model and vocoder reference.

responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.name: Grad-TTS: A Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Text-to-Speech
responsible_ai_and_multimodal_primary_so.relevance: Primary diffusion acoustic-model source for TTS quality and sampling-speed trade-offs.

governance_and_security.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
governance_and_security.relevance: Governance baseline for AI risk management, documentation, accountability, and controls.

governance_and_security.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
governance_and_security.relevance: Regulatory baseline affecting documentation, monitoring, and high-risk model governance.

governance_and_security.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
governance_and_security.relevance: Secure development practices relevant for DS pipelines and service handoff.

governance_and_security.name: NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
governance_and_security.relevance: Useful governance reference when DS work overlaps with GenAI systems or agentic evaluation.
